proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s X Y H _ hH hperp
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere'.mp h.mem_sphere
  · intro h
    refine ⟨EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere'.mpr h, hH, ?_⟩
    intro Q hQ
    have hsub : Q -ᵥ H ∈ (line[ℝ, X, Y]).direction := AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction hQ hH
    rw [direction_affineSpan, mem_vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hsub
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hsub
    refine EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mem_orthRadius_iff_inner_left.mpr ?_
    rw [← hk, inner_smul_left, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev s.center H, inner_neg_right, real_inner_comm, hperp]
    simp
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (X Y H : P), X ≠ Y → H ∈ line[ℝ, X, Y] → inner ℝ (s.center -ᵥ H) (Y -ᵥ X) = 0 → (s.IsTangentAt H line[ℝ, X, Y] ↔ dist s.center H = s.radius)
